versions.content: The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyTriggerTransmit Services from the Rte_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has LdComTxTrig- gerTransmit configured [SWS_LDCOM_00047].
